explanation: OEIS A046969 (denominators of the Stirling series coefficients B_{2n}/(2n(2n−1)) for log Γ), L. Sauras Altuzarra's Conjecture II: 'if a(n)/12 is prime, then a(n−1)/12 − (n−1), a(n)/12 − n, and a(n+2)/12 − (n+2) are multiples of 6', reported false at n = 236791. The formal a matches the definition. The formal negation adds the side hypotheses 12 | a(n), 12 | a(n−1), 12 | a(n+2) (needed for the divisions to mean what the comment intends), which makes the refuted universal statement weaker and the negation correspondingly stronger, so it is a faithful disproof. Faithful.
